爱莎贝儿-140CM-M 粉肤 RAD053 朝比奈小枝Asahina Sae-气呼呼的甜蜜反击
她气鼓鼓地推我，却被我抱住后脸红到耳根。
“哼……别以为这样就行！”
精灵少女扭动着丰盈身躯抗议，却主动缠上双腿，激烈回应我的吻，
最后喘息着低头：“笨蛋……我最喜欢你了。”
身型：140CM-M 粉肤

Elsa Babe-140CM-M Pink RAD053 Asahina Sae-Angry and sweet counterattack
She pushed me away angrily, but I caught her, and her face turned red to the roots of her ears.
"Hmph... Don't think that's enough!" The elven girl protested, wriggling her voluptuous body, but then wrapped her legs around mine, responding passionately to my kiss.
Finally, panting, she lowered her head: "Idiot... I love you the most."
Body type: 140CM-M with Pink skin tone.
